result.title: Cecilia: Towards Layout-Inclusive Optical Music Recognition
result.summary: Reconstructing an editable music score requires musical events, sung text and the instructions that organise them on the page. Existing recognition targets often omit part of this information, while direct MusicXML prediction repeats substantial structural markup. We introduce Cecilia, a compact representation of canonicalised MusicXML that retains musical content, lyric attachments and layout instructions. Cecilia-OMR predicts this representation through metadata and measure-bounded music segments from shared visual memory. A learned count head determines the number of output segments. Across paired complete scores under a common tokeniser, the ratio of mean MusicXML to Cecilia sequence lengths is 27.73. Cecilia-OMR outperforms Legato 2 on Camera String Quartets and both Lieder conditions, with a four-condition OpenScore macro normalised edit distance of 0.2232 against 0.2998. Separate evaluations of lyrics, notation trees and rendered layout reveal complementary aspects of reconstruction and quantify the contribution of layout instructions. Training-stage, reward and candidate-selection studies further examine how recognition changes across model adaptation and decoding.

AI.brief_summary: 提出紧凑的规范化 MusicXML 表示 Cecilia，保留音符内容、歌词绑定与版面指令，并构建 Cecilia-OMR：基于共享视觉记忆按小节切段预测该表示，用学得计数头决定输出段数，在 OpenScore 多条件下优于 Legato 2。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「计数头决定输出段数」与「共享视觉记忆下分段解码」分别可能为 LVR 的停止决策和视觉证据复用提供可核查线索，但任务属乐谱识别，迁移价值需读原文确认。
